note: No IRW processing script found in data/ (git grep heekerens: none); the live table equals the deposit column-for-column: each live PHQ_n has exactly the 1..4 frequency vector of deposit phq_n and of no other phq column (e.g. PHQ_8 16/32/24/16, PHQ_1 1/33/34/20), so the code derivation is a number-preserving rename phq_n -> PHQ_n. The deposit carries no item wording at any level and the paper is closed, so code -> wording rests on the standard PHQ numbering (PHQ-8 = PHQ-9 items 1-8): mapping_basis=paper_order in the instrument-order sense (baquerotomas_2026_phq9 / ren_2024_phq9 precedent). Step 5b PARTIAL (verification_heekerens2025_phq.csv): PHQ-2 core pair {1,2} are each other's strongest correlate (r=0.529), item 8 (psychomotor) has the lowest mean (2.45 vs 2.83-3.30) and highest floor (18.2% vs 1.1-9.1%); order among items 3-7 and 1 vs 2 not pinned. Step 3b: 8 live items, resp 1-4; Zenodo description names the PHQ-8 -- matches. Administered language German (German-language validation in German clinical samples; Zenodo: 'German version'). The administered form was not published by the study; item_text/instructions/option_text are the standard German PHQ-D wording (Pfizer German-for-Germany form, which is the Loewe et al. PHQ-D text; the KBV/UKE copy agrees word-for-word except trivial punctuation: KBV item 2 ends with '.', item 3 lacks the comma after 'Schwierigkeiten', item 7 reads 'Zeitunglesen'). That the study used this wording is an inference from 'German version of the PHQ-8', not read from study materials -> text_source=canonical_instrument. Deviations: item 3's source 'durchzuschlafen,oder' (missing space) corrected to 'durchzuschlafen, oder'; instructions omit the form's '(Bitte markieren Sie die zutreffende Antwort mit "check")' marking line and the PHQ-9 difficulty question (not in the table); header anchors 'Über-haupt nicht', 'An einzel-nen Tagen', 'Bei-nahe jeden Tag' de-hyphenated from the column-header line breaks. _translated = official English PHQ-9 items 1-8 (parallel version, official_instrument_english). Option axis: canonical scoring 0-3; the deposit/live table store 1-4 (every item spans 1..4). Direction from data: PHQ total correlates +0.460 with the DSS total and +0.386 with the PDS-5 total in the same deposit, so higher resp = more frequent symptoms and resp = PHQ score + 1 (1 = 'Überhaupt nicht' .. 4 = 'Beinahe jeden Tag'); PHQ-8 total on 0-3 scoring M=15.74 SD=4.38 (n=88), plausible for a clinical sample. This resolves the index-sheet note 'resp clash: irw use 1-4, codebook use 0-3'. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv row 'PHQ and GAD screener family' verdict=ship (express grant), applied; the German PDF footer carries the same grant: 'Für die Vervielfältigung, Übersetzung, Darstellung oder Verteilung ist keine Genehmigung erforderlich.' public_note: The study's German PHQ-8 form was not published, so the item text shown is the standard German PHQ-D wording with the official English PHQ-9 alongside; item order is assumed to follow the standard PHQ numbering, and resp 1-4 are the usual 0-3 scores shifted up by one (1 = Überhaupt nicht / Not at all, 4 = Beinahe jeden Tag / Nearly every day).

note: MAPPING (data_labels): the study survey export headers carry each Chinese stem with its survey position (e.g. 感觉紧张，焦虑或急切t12 .. 感到似乎将有可怕的事情发生而害怕t18); the study own scripts/extract-dataset-from-excel.py renames them by explicit dict(zip(gad7_cols, gad7_cols_rename)) to question1..question7, which is the Zenodo gad7.csv header; data/su_2024_xinxiang_assessments.R then renames questionN -> GAD_N via an explicit item map (number-preserving). metadata/GAD-7.csv (Index 1-7, Question_Context) is generated from that same header list and its 7 stems are shipped verbatim, 7/7. WORDS: item_text is the administered Chinese exactly as the study recorded it. The study wording is NOT the phqscreeners official Chinese-for-China translation (GAD7_Chinese for China.pdf, sha256 eb4154243805de80b699b135f164e19d22035f549bf9b3cd33d17c952466be5f, e.g. official item 1 感觉紧张、焦虑或不安 vs study 感觉紧张，焦虑或急切) - it is a different Chinese translation, so the official Chinese instructions/anchors were NOT used. The deposit, the GitHub repo (metadata, scripts, notebooks) and the paper supplement record no instructions and no response-option labels (supplement: each item scored 0 to 3 only; the paper says options are in the GitHub repo, but they are not). So instructions and option_text are blank. The _translated columns carry the publisher English (official_instrument_english) as a parallel version: item_text_translated, option_text_translated (Not at all..Nearly every day on resp 0-3, the canonical GAD-7 scoring, direction confirmed by the band match) and instructions_translated; these are not translations of administered strings, and item 5 (由于不安而无法静坐, roughly unable to sit still because of restlessness) and item 7 diverge in phrasing from the English. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register row PHQ and GAD screener family = ship (express grant: no permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute), applied; a third-party Chinese translation is a translation the grant expressly permits. No response-data defects: 170,044 rows = 24,292 x 7, every item 0-3 with all four levels used, score == sum in gad7.csv for all rows.
